summary: internal/client/client.go's doInternal() injects an auth_secret field into every map-shaped write request body from config, and dryRun() masks that field before printing.
reason: Workiz requires a second credential, the API secret, as a JSON body field named auth_secret on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE call, not a header. The generator has no spec-level mechanism to auto-populate a body field from config, so this was added at the single shared request-building path so every generated write command gets it automatically without a per-command flag. The dry-run masking fix was added after a security review caught the injected secret printing in cleartext in --dry-run output while the URL/header were already masked.
validated_outcome: Verified via --dry-run smoke test: auth_secret appears masked (****<last4>) in the printed body preview, matching the masking already applied to the Authorization header and query params in the same output.
